name: Shrimp
overview: The topic of shrimp, categorized under miscellaneous, is addressed in Scripture with limited direct reference, as shown by the sample verses. While none of the provided verses explicitly mention shrimp or its consumption, the passages from Ezekiel speak of flesh and impurity metaphorically, highlighting the importance of holiness and separation from defilement. This suggests that eating shrimp, as a subject, may be considered within the broader biblical framework of clean and unclean foods, emphasizing obedience to God’s commands regarding purity.
